subject: english
question:
Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains an error.

Dad, will you get me a box of crayons / on your way home? Teacher told us yesterday, “You must bring / a box of crayons with you to the drawing class./ Or I will not be let you stay in the class.”

options.text: Or I will not be let you stay in the class”.
on your way home? Teacher told us yesterday, “You must bring
Dad, will you get me a box of crayons
a box of crayons with you to the drawing class.

solution:
The correct answer is "**Or I will not be let you stay in the class**."
